# Project Quill

Project Quill is digitizing the institute's handwritten field logbooks from
1950 to 1990, so that old weather and tide notes can be searched.

## Team and equipment

The project is led by [[amara-nwosu]] and runs from [[tolvan-lab]]. Pages
are captured with the [[scanner-rig-sr1]].
